sections.title: Content
sections.text:
Test resources: SQLite :memory:, PostgreSQL 16.14 at 25432, MySQL 8.4.10 at 23306, MariaDB 10.11.19 at 23307. Server databases azguard_test, TestCase rejects non-_test names. Docker compose up -d --wait postgres mysql mariadb passed under explicit port variables; existing P3-models/environment.md carries exact command.
PHPStan and type coverage run with php -d phpstan.restarted=1 due to previously established static PHP/turbo dynamic extension incompatibility. Arch and full tests use memory_limit=1G.
Task transition symptom: after P3.3 durable terminal, finalize required handoff title after P3.3. Resolved by updating handoff and reducer-owned continuity, then finalize succeeded. Resumed batch requires receipt membership P3.3/P3.4 but request remaining suffix P3.4. Automatic Codex capture for suffix returned ROUTE_LAUNCH_MISMATCH because provider prompt names original P3.3/P3.4 invocation. Safe fallback: adapter-owned task.route_evidence_codex capture of the exact original invocation -> current-route.json; pass --actual-route with unchanged provider evidence plus rebuilt Task batch receipt to prepare P3.4. No route or permission self-attestation. P3.4-prepare.json records START_ITEM, frontier/high. Owning tool source is swissknifeman/packages/task; no external repository mutation in this execution scope.
Direct-write path gap observed in test: inherited static Model::destroy performs an unbound preliminary read before delete, producing QueryException instead of required UnsupportedDirectWriteException. Added final static destroy rejection before query; test rerun GREEN. Installed Laravel 13 additionally exposes saveOrIgnore, model incrementEach/Quietly methods and Builder::touch; all guarded. Cross-version qualification remains P8.4.
Read-only independent reviewer launched explicitly as grok --cwd /home/vostrikov/projects/packages/azguard --model grok-4.7 --reasoning-effort high --permission-mode plan --no-subagents --disable-web-search --max-turns 40 --output-format json --prompt-file /tmp/azguard-grok-p3-review.txt. Review scope P3.3/P3.4; full phase Review P3 remains P3.5.

Initial Grok review RED, R1; root confirmed installed Query::insertOrIgnoreReturning (SQLite) and Query::updateFrom (PostgreSQL) write bypass without panel version bump, captured bypass-*-before.log. Repaired in owning P3.4, all declared checks rerun exit 0. Delta review resumes exact Grok session with same model/high and read-only settings, --max-turns 8. P3.3 has no blocker/major and no product repair.

Post-close plan-lint found one new handoff error: successor P3.5 Routing is solo, but handoff retained completed B3b. Corrected successor Batch to solo; completed B3b membership remains in terminal journal receipt. Baseline has 12 historical P0/P1 printed-write-site errors outside selected dependency closure; gate=new used and rerun after metadata repair.
Final scoped plan lint: --baseline HEAD --gate new exit 0, new errors 0; unchanged baseline errors 12. plan-lint-final.log retains full diagnostic (all-errors verdict remains FAILURE). Generated P3.4/P3.5 bundles checked.
